primary.usage: Add task actions, the today badge, focus outlines.

danger.usage: Active sidebar text, Reschedule, overdue dates, errors.

priority-1.usage: Priority 1 completion circle and flag only.

priority-2.usage: Priority 2 completion circle and flag only.

priority-3.usage: Priority 3 completion circle and flag only.

priority-4.usage: Priority 4 completion circle and flag only.

due-today.usage: Date line of a task due today only.

due-tomorrow.usage: Date line of a task due tomorrow only.

due-week.usage: Date line of a task due in the next 2 to 7 days only.

section-heading.purpose: Day headings, Overdue, sidebar section labels.

body.purpose: Task titles, nav items, Add task rows.

rules: Animate color and the overdue chevron rotation only.
No layout animation; the drawer opens instantly.
Opening or collapsing the sidebar never moves the centered column.

button.defaultClassName: inline-flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors duration-150 focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-primary disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50
rules: One primary button per surface at most.

sidebarItem.defaultClassName: flex h-9 items-center gap-2.5 rounded-md px-2 text-sm transition-colors
rules: Switch active and inactive colors through the router's active props.
Heading format: day month, relative name, weekday.
Every day ends with an Add task row.

do: Keep the list column centered and at most 768px wide.
Use red only for actions, the current day and overdue state.
Show skeletons until the browser's local date is known.
dont: Do not add cards, shadows or gradients.
Do not open modals for one- or two-field actions.
Do not introduce projects, boards or team visuals.
